headline: Oil hub hit: Multiple explosions rock Iran's Kharg Island and Qeshm
summary: Kharg Island, which handles nearly 90% of Iran's crude oil exports, has been targeted in a series of blasts, escalating tensions in the Persian Gulf.
details: Multiple explosions were reported on Kharg Island, a strategically and economically critical hub for Iran. State media also reported similar blasts on Qeshm Island in the Persian Gulf, raising fears of intensified military tension in the Middle East.

According to Press TV, sounds of several explosions were heard on Kharg Island. However, no immediate details regarding the cause of the blasts, the extent of the damage, or casualty figures have been released.

Kharg Island is located approximately five miles off the Iranian coast and serves as the primary center for the country's oil exports. Approximately 90% of Iran's total crude oil exports are sent to international markets via this island's terminals.
Qeshm Island, the largest island in the Persian Gulf, was also hit by explosions. This island is considered a vital part of Iran's coastal defense system and is located near the Strait of Hormuz.

The United States has previously carried out attacks on both Kharg and Qeshm islands. Former President Donald Trump has also publicly mentioned the possibility of taking control of Iran's critical oil infrastructure, including Kharg Island.
The Iranian military and relevant authorities have not yet issued an official detailed statement regarding the latest explosions on the islands.

headline_marked: Rock band Warfaze [[announces 8th studio album]] with 12 new songs
headline: Rock band Warfaze announces 8th studio album with 12 new songs
summary: The band has released the first track 'Girgiti' and plans to roll out the remaining songs gradually, with a full release target by 2027.
details: Legendary rock band Warfaze has announced the arrival of their eighth studio album. While the album title remains a secret for now, the band revealed it will feature 12 songs in total.
The first track, 'Girgiti', was released last Tuesday, with its official music video set to premiere on the Loy Records YouTube channel on July 6.
Band leader and drummer Sheikh Monirul Alam Tipu told Prothom Alo that the full album release will take time due to their busy international touring schedule.
The band is heading to the UK on July 9, with concerts scheduled for London on July 11 and July 19, before returning to Bangladesh on July 23.
Following their UK tour, Warfaze plans to embark on a tour of the United States next month if everything goes as planned.
Because of these tours, they expect to release one or two more songs this year, with the rest following next year and the complete collection available by 2027.
caption:
12 new songs and a global tour! Warfaze is back with their 8th studio album.

Legendary rock band Warfaze has announced the arrival of their eighth studio album. While the album title remains a secret for now, the band revealed it will feature 12 songs in total.

The first track, 'Girgiti', was released last Tuesday, with its official music video set to premiere on the Loy Records YouTube channel on July 6.

Band leader and drummer Sheikh Monirul Alam Tipu told Prothom Alo that the full album release will take time due to their busy international touring schedule.

The band is heading to the UK on July 9, with concerts scheduled for London on July 11 and July 19, before returning to Bangladesh on July 23.

Following their UK tour, Warfaze plans to embark on a tour of the United States next month if everything goes as planned.

Because of these tours, they expect to release one or two more songs this year, with the rest following next year and the complete collection available by 2027.

Source: Prothom Alo
